before.direct_and_class_associative_pop_forms: All four parenthesized/unparenthesized forms compile with exit 0 in both editions, despite being queue-only methods.

change: Reject pop_front/pop_back on an assoc_compat receiver in the shared explicit-call helper and both parenthesis-free direct and class-property paths; keep indexed associative-array elements whose element type is a queue eligible.

tests.negative: Four invalid forms in one fixture produce four exact errors and compile exit 4 in both editions.
